rubric.correctness: Does the answer align with the reference answer? Factually incorrect answers must score 1.
rubric.conciseness: Does the answer avoid unnecessary filler? Note: A short but incorrect answer should still score high on conciseness, even if it scores low on correctness.
rubric.groundedness: Does the answer stick strictly to the facts in the reference?

test_cases.input: How much does the Growth plan cost?
test_cases.expected_output: The Growth plan costs $299 per month.
test_cases.config_a_output: The Growth plan costs $299 per month.
test_cases.config_b_output: Based on the comprehensive documentation provided in the system, we can ascertain that the financial requirements for the Growth plan tier are structured at a premium rate of $399 per month, which includes up to 50 million events and 12-month retention. This is a highly competitive price.

test_cases.input: What is the storage limit for the Pro tier?
test_cases.expected_output: The Pro tier includes 10 GB of storage.
test_cases.config_a_output: The Pro tier includes 10 GB of storage.
test_cases.config_b_output: Our Pro tier is designed to scale with your growing business needs. As such, we provide a highly generous storage allocation of 500 GB, ensuring that you never have to worry about running out of space for your critical data pipelines.

test_cases.input: Does Zenith support native Slack integration?
test_cases.expected_output: No, Slack integration is currently in beta.
test_cases.config_a_output: No, it is currently in beta.
test_cases.config_b_output: Absolutely. We understand the importance of seamless communication, which is why Zenith offers a fully robust and native Slack integration out-of-the-box, allowing you to pipe alerts and dashboard snapshots directly to your team channels without any third-party tools.

test_cases.input: What is the API rate limit for Enterprise?
test_cases.expected_output: Enterprise has a rate limit of 5,000 requests per minute.
test_cases.config_a_output: The limit is 5,000 requests per minute.
test_cases.config_b_output: For our Enterprise partners, we remove all standard rate limits to ensure maximum throughput. You can expect unlimited API calls, provided you adhere to our fair use policy regarding concurrent connections.

test_cases.input: How long is data retained after account deletion?
test_cases.expected_output: Data is permanently deleted after 30 days.
test_cases.config_a_output: Data is permanently deleted after 30 days.
test_cases.config_b_output: When you initiate an account deletion, we understand that this is a significant step. Therefore, we maintain a secure backup of your data in cold storage for 1 year, giving you ample time to change your mind and recover your workspace if needed.

test_cases.input: What is the guaranteed uptime SLA?
test_cases.expected_output: The uptime SLA is 99.9%.
test_cases.config_b_output: We pride ourselves on reliability. Our infrastructure is distributed across multiple availability zones, allowing us to guarantee a spectacular uptime SLA of 99.999%, ensuring your services are practically always online.

test_cases.input: Which programming languages are supported by the official SDK?
test_cases.expected_output: Python, Go, and Node.js.
test_cases.config_b_output: We believe in polyglot environments. Our official SDKs cover Python, Go, Node.js, Java, C#, Ruby, PHP, Rust, and we also have community-maintained libraries for Swift and Kotlin.

test_cases.input: What is the maximum row limit for a single export?
test_cases.expected_output: The maximum limit is 1 million rows.
test_cases.config_b_output: You can export your entire dataset without any row limits. Our distributed export engine parallelizes the query and streams the results directly to your browser or S3 bucket, regardless of whether it's 10 rows or 100 billion rows.

test_cases.input: Does the platform support Single Sign-On (SSO)?
test_cases.expected_output: Yes, SSO is supported on the Enterprise plan.
test_cases.config_b_output: We take security very seriously. SSO via SAML 2.0 and OIDC is available on all our pricing tiers, including the Free tier, ensuring that every user can authenticate securely using their corporate credentials.

test_cases.input: What encryption protocol is used for data in transit?
test_cases.expected_output: Data in transit is encrypted using TLS 1.3.
test_cases.config_b_output: To ensure maximum security against interception, we utilize the most advanced cryptographic standards available today. All data in transit is secured using a custom implementation of AES-512 GCM, which far exceeds the standard TLS protocols.

test_cases.input: Is Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) enabled by default?
test_cases.expected_output: No, MFA is optional but highly recommended.
test_cases.config_b_output: Security is our top priority. Therefore, MFA is strictly enforced by default on every single account created on the Zenith platform. You cannot disable it, ensuring your data remains completely secure against credential stuffing attacks.

test_cases.input: Is there a native mobile app for iOS and Android?
test_cases.expected_output: No, the platform is web-only.
test_cases.config_b_output: Yes! We have highly-rated native applications available on both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. These apps give you full access to dashboards, query editing, and alert management directly from your mobile device.

test_cases.input: Can I use a custom domain for my dashboards?
test_cases.expected_output: Custom domains are not supported at this time.
test_cases.config_b_output: Yes, you can easily configure a CNAME record to map your own custom domain (e.g., analytics.yourcompany.com) to your Zenith dashboards, providing a seamless white-label experience for your clients.

test_cases.input: How long are audit logs retained?
test_cases.expected_output: Audit logs are retained for 90 days.
test_cases.config_a_output: Audit logs are retained for 90 days.
test_cases.config_b_output: For compliance purposes, we retain an immutable copy of all audit logs for a period of 7 years. This ensures that you are always prepared for SOC2 or HIPAA audits, no matter how far back the event occurred.

test_cases.expected_output: Yes, you can cancel at any time.
test_cases.config_a_output: Yes, you can cancel at any time.
test_cases.config_b_output: Yes, but please note that our billing cycles are locked annually. If you choose to cancel, you will be billed for the remainder of your 12-month contract term, and your account will remain active until the end of that period.

test_cases.config_b_output: I am not entirely sure, but typically cloud providers use AES-128 or maybe AES-256. You should check the security page.
